info.title: API.SH: Subito.it
info.description: The Subito.it API from API.SH: public Subito.it data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.summary: Fetch a past response again, free
get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

200.description: The stored response (headers: x-refetch: 1, x-original-time, x-original-route).

404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

get.description:
Subito.it's macro categories and their categories with ids and slugs (the search's category filter).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/subito-categories

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Subito.it ad: price, full description, every feature, photos, location, posting date, the seller's feedback score and reply time and, for business sellers, the shop (name, slogan, description, logo, website, opening hours, phone, categories, ad count). Pass `url`, or `latest=1` with search params. Private sellers' names, phone numbers and email addresses are never returned (masked in ad text).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/subito-listing

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: `1`: open the first current result of a search made with this route's search params (q, location and filters) instead of an id. Ads expire, so this keeps a link working.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Italy's regions as Subito lists them (id, name, slug, neighbouring regions), or with `region` that region's provinces (id, name, code), for the search's location filters.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/subito-regions

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: A region id for its provinces (e.g. 4 for Lombardia).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Subito.it (Italy) classified ads for a keyword with category, region, province, town, ad type, price, seller type, shipping, title-only and sort. Each result has price, condition, every listed feature, photos, location (region, province, town), posting and expiry dates and, for businesses, the shop. `applied_filters` echoes what the site applied. Private sellers' names, phone numbers and email addresses are never returned (masked in ad text).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/subito-search

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Subito category id (2 Auto, 3 Moto, 7 Appartamenti, 10 Informatica, 12 Telefonia, 14 Arredamento, 41 Biciclette).

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Region id (4 Lombardia, 5 Veneto, 8 Toscana, 11 Lazio, 13 Abruzzo, 15 Campania, 20 Sicilia).

parameters.name: title_only
parameters.description: true: match keywords in titles only.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Results page, 1 for the first. Pass back `next_page`; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: One of the advertiser's subito.it ad links (or its id), instead of user_id.

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
